administration.note: Packet sizes and assignment are operational engineering defaults, not claims about psychometric or sample-size adequacy. No engineering scoring model is assigned to the successor bank. The 0.11 research pool includes NEI122; the public Full route separately administers NEI014@1. The 0.12 research pool includes NEI123; the public Full route also administers the prior NEI122@1 criterion question. The 0.13 research pool includes AHI108@1; the public routes replace AHI104@1 in a separate versioned release. The 0.14 research pool includes EPI122@1; the public routes replace EPI021@1 in a separate versioned release. The 0.15 research pool includes NEI121@1; Full replaces NEI101@1 in a separately versioned public release. The 0.16 research pool includes EPI123@1; Full replaces EPI104@1 and EPI105@1 in a separately versioned public release. The 0.17 research pool includes NEI124@2 and NEI132@1; only the successor Full route administers both. The 0.18 research pool includes NEI133@1 and NEI125@2; the direct total-well-being criterion is on Full only. The 0.19 research pool includes PLI060@2 and PLI123@2; the scoped production-control proposition is on Full only. The 0.20 research pool adds NEI134@1 and NEI135@1; the direct evidence path is Full-only. The 0.21 research pool updates PLI072@2 and PLI073@2 for extreme-injustice limits and adds PLI128@1 for ordinary immoral-law validity.

privacy.respondentKeyMeaning: Opaque pseudonymous key only when repeated-session linkage is intentionally required.
